svg.text: east coast market belt: 3 candidate promises
T1: 15 links - T1 candidate trunk promise
T2: 6 links - T2 candidate market connector
T3: 3 links - T3 candidate access / terminal feeder
Shows China as multiple service markets, not one coast-to-coast line.
Ask which promises matter first: export gateways, inland reliability,
Official route roles, policy alignment, legal SLAs, construction, cost,
Held claims: official network, legal SLA, construction readiness, costs, numeric ROI, funding eligibility, compliance, endorsement, external validation, and public readiness.
Use as a client discovery surface: replace heuristic rows with country-specific source rows before making stronger claims.
